# llm_behavior_defaults_and_errors

LLM extraction is disabled unless configured; include_tests defaults to false (tests are excluded unless include_tests is true). If the LLM provider is unavailable the compile is degraded and continues with a warning; if the LLM budget is exceeded an LLMBudgetExceeded is raised and the compile fails (CompileError).

Allow optional semantic extraction while preserving deterministic compilation when provider problems occur and fail only on budget exhaustion (resumable failure).
